fields.name: id
fields.description: Opaque, stable identifier of the source: the first twelve hex digits of a hash of its normalised address and the archive timestamp.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: What kind of source it is.

fields.name: title
fields.description: The title of the source as a reader sees it.

fields.name: date
fields.description: The date the source speaks for: its publication date if it shows one, else the capture date of the archived copy, else the day it was fetched.

fields.name: url
fields.description: The address of the source on the web.

fields.name: archive_url
fields.description: The address of the Wayback Machine copy that was read, if one was.

fields.name: fetched
fields.description: When the source was read, in UTC.

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Anything a reader of the source needs to know.
